args.script:
# Count characters, words, lines from all .txt files, and count subdirectories
CHARS=$(find test_directory/ -type f -name "*.txt" -exec cat {} + | wc -m)
WORDS=$(find test_directory/ -type f -name "*.txt" -exec cat {} + | wc -w)
LINES=$(find test_directory/ -type f -name "*.txt" -exec cat {} + | wc -l)
FOLDERS=$(find test_directory/ -mindepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
echo "Chars: $CHARS, Words: $WORDS, Lines: $LINES, Folders: $FOLDERS"
echo "Total: $((CHARS + WORDS + LINES + FOLDERS))"
